title: Shanghai: Banri no Choujou: The Great Wall
overview:
With four types of games, Shanghai has changed dramatically.

Shanghai: The Great Wall is a set of tile-matching puzzles played with mahjong tiles. Alongside Classic Shanghai, where you clear a stacked layout by picking off free matching pairs, there are three new games: The Great Wall, Beijing and the head-to-head Golden Tile. Two players can team up on the same board at the same time, or face off in Golden Tile.

- Original Mode: play without a timer and pick the game, layout, background, tile set, music and difficulty, with unlimited undo and hints
- Arcade Mode: timed 30-stage runs with scoring, limited hints and undos, and a memory bonus stage every three stages
- Password continues
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- Memory backup

4種類のゲームで、上海がドラマチックに変わりました。
